name: Obliter8 4.5 Gram Disposable - Starfighter - Hybrid - Live Resin
description:
Blast off into a stratospheric high with Starfighter! Crafted from Alien Tahoe OG and Lemon Alien Dawg, this strain's unique blend has sparked excitement among connoisseurs for its sweet earthy lavender onset that has a sharp pungent lemony pine aftertaste upon exhale. Ignite your senses and launch into a warm and fuzzy relaxed state of exploration!

Details

• Starfighter (Hybrid)

• 4.5 Gram Disposable Vape

• Obliter8: Eight-Cannabinoid Obliter8 Live Resin Blend

How To Use

• 5 clicks - ON/OFF

• 2 Clicks - preheat

• Connect device to USB-C cord for charging

• Activate device and inhale

• USB-C cord not included

Cannabinoids

• Delta-6

• Delta-8

• Delta-9

• THCB

• THCH

• THCJD

• THCP

• THCX

What is Delta-6?

Delta-6 provides an energetic buzz

Expect a mild, yet euphoric high with Delta-6. This naturally occurring cannabinoid is rare and present in small quantities in the hemp plant. Delta-6 provides an energetic buzz that will have you uplifted and its invigorating effects may inspire a burst of motivation, making it an appealing choice for those seeking a boost of focus and energy.

What is Delta-8?

Delta-8 is made from pure CBD

Delta-8, the godfather molecule of the industry, offers a user-friendly experience that is similar to Delta-9. It's perfect for inexperienced consumers and referred to by us as "diet weed" because of its softer effects on the body and mind while providing all the benefits of actual cannabis. Delta-8 is made from pure CBD isolate and is another magical gift from these amazing hemp plants.

What is Delta-9?

Delta-9 has more psychoactive effects than Delta-8

Discover the most abundant THC compound found in cannabis that offers slightly more psychoactive effects than Delta-8! This amazing compound metabolizes in the liver and other organs some time after consumption, providing an incredible euphoric relaxation experience that's sure to leave you feeling blissful and serene.

What is THCB?

THCB has potential therapeutic benefits

THCB (tetrahydrocannabivarin), is a unique cannabinoid closely related to THC. It has its own distinct effects on the body and mind and while it’s non-intoxicating, THCB has potential therapeutic benefits and when combined with other cannabinoids the synergistic effects are endless.

What is THCH? 

THCH brings about a burst of joy

THCH, aka The Happy Cannabinoid, is a remarkable compound that brings about a burst of joy and happiness. This unique and cannabinoid is celebrated for its blissful and transcendent effects, creating a sense of joy and contentment. Its gentle and soothing nature makes it a preferred choice for those desiring a cheerful and relaxed experience.

What is THCJD?

THCJD enhanced clarity and focus

THCJD (tetrahydrocannabioctyl) is a potent compound that combines the euphoric effects of THC with enhanced clarity and focus. Get ready to embark on a deeply relaxing and calming experience, along with a heightened sensory perception. THCJD has quickly gained popularity among those seeking a balanced and enjoyable cannabis experience.

What is THCP?

THCP unforgettable high

Experience an unforgettable high with THCP, the most potent THC cannabinoid. THCP offers immediate and highly psychoactive effects that are approximately 33x as strong as Delta-9.

What is THCX?

THCX is a novel cannabinoid

THCX is a novel cannabinoid that is capturing the attention of cannabis enthusiasts. With its unique properties, it offers a fresh perspective on the cannabis experience. Similar to THC, THCX interacts with the endocannabinoid system, potentially delivering a range of effects including euphoria, relaxation and psychoactive experiences.

What is Live Resin?

Live Resin maintains the potency and rich flavors

Live Resin is the extraction process that uses frozen Hemp plants. This extraction process aims to maintain the potency and rich flavors of the Hemp plant while preventing oxidation.
